messages:
Lia (platform): Hey team — Crypton VPC cutover planned for Wed 03/10 02:00UTC. Final sync: owners & blockers. Egress, certs, airgap packages, and fallback plan. Who's owning egress IP allocation and NAT fallbacks?
Sam (netops): I'll own egress. I need final list of destination IP ranges from Crypton app team. @Carlos can you confirm NAT gateway quotas in staging? link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/egress
Carlos (infra): NAT quotas are fine for staging, prod needs resize. I'll open a ticket to bump to 4x. Also confirmed route table peering works.
Mike R: cert rotation for the mTLS certs is scheduled Mon 03/08 18:00PT. Will wire up automation to rotate on cutover. Reminder: self-signed fallback exists if ACME fails.
Aisha (security): KMS customer key in scope? Crypton requested HSM-backed keys. @Priya do we have KMS policy checklist done?
Priya (sec-eng): KMS policy drafted, awaiting legal signoff on BYOK CLA. For HSM we need customer key import window and audit logs enabled. Blocking until legal thumbs up.
InfraBot: automated preflight checks ran — storage snapshot ok, disk encryption ok, image hash matches. failing_checks: none. See /checks/1945678901
Carlos (infra): One small network note: private DNS entries for crypton-app.{env}.svc need SRV records added. Lia can you confirm the env mapping?
Lia (platform): confirmed env mapping sent to crypton SRE earlier. Also adding a quick fallback policy: if egress NAT is saturated, route to dedicated fallback region — will add policy to routing config.
Sam (netops): for fallback I propose using dualstack NAT + per-customer SNAT pools. Config snippet: `ip nat pool crypton 100.64.0.100 100.64.0.199 netmask 255.255.255.0`
Aisha (security): quick check — will we have packet capture for 24h post-cutover? Need to enable on all gateways.
Mike R: yes, packet capture scheduled, will keep for 48h and then drop to 24h. :thumbsup:
Priya (sec-eng): legal responded — signoff expected Tue EOD. If legal delays, we can proceed with non-HSM KMS with audit logs turned up.
Sam (netops): I'm good to own egress. Carlos will handle NAT resize ticket. Priya/Aisha — ping when legal + KMS ok. Lia — do you want a canary rollout window?
Lia (platform): yes — 10% traffic canary for 1 hour, then 50% for 30 mins if metrics green. I'll open canary rollout in Console and tag responsible owners. Thanks!
deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance window created: Crypton VPC cutover 2026-03-10 02:00UTC. Canary targets: crypton-prod-1 (10%).
Lia (platform): adding final checklist here: - egress owner assigned (Sam) - NAT ticket (Carlos) - cert rotation (Mike R) - KMS/legal (Priya/Aisha) - packet capture (Mike R) - DNS SRV entries (Carlos) - canary rollout (Lia). If anyone sees a missing owner call it out now. :eyes:
